span.p:
content altered, prev hash mismatch,
seq out of order

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
merkle root mismatch,
checkpoint covers wrong block

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
differs from external anchor,
log truncated

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: not a JSON array or schema error

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Reason code in the
audit 'policy' entry
(fleetgate explain CODE)

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Id not in catalogue; matching is exact (no trim,
case or Unicode folding). Use fleetgate runbooks.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Host not in the fleet or outside the incident.
Check the id against the incident's hosts.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
On the policy deny_list: never runs, even approved.
Pick another runbook or edit deny_list in your own policy copy.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Change freeze. Wait, or add a maintenance_window for the DC
(reopens DISRUPTIVE on unprotected hosts only).

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Reason names the false precondition (host_drained, ticket_open,
bmc_reachable...). Run drain_host / open_ticket first.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Transient: the step retries itself for up to 20 ticks. To loosen raise
cooldown_ticks / max_actions_per_tick / rate_limits / quotas.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Would leave too few active hosts of a role (last db-primary).
Add a spare host of that role first.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Campaign: one canary must verify first. PENDING: wait.
FAILED: frozen; fix the runbook or its probe.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
A human said no or nobody answered in expire_after_ticks.
Read the approval note; check who is on the pool.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Gate failed closed on malformed input.
Read the reason text and report it.

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
No approver wired or approver=hold.
Use --approver auto|interactive|humans.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
N-of-M unmet: roles outside the pool or the same person twice
do not count; stacked pools need different people.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Nobody answered in expire_after_ticks.
Raise escalation.expire_after_ticks or staff the pool.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Drained hosts stop reporting: a fault that
starts after the drain is invisible by design.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
bmc_unreachable hides temp/fan/psu, ssh_unreachable hides
OS metrics: alert on the reachability signal.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
A signal must persist confirm_ticks=2; slow ramps cross
thresholds late and EWMA can absorb them.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Folded into a group incident (grp-*).
Use --no-correlate to see per-host incidents.

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Entry N was edited, deleted or reordered: everything from N
is untrusted. Restore from backup.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p: Wrong key (pass --key-env VAR) or a forged entry.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A key is set but entry N has no signature:
stripped, or the log started unsigned.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p: A checkpoint, or an entry it covers, was tampered with.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rewritten or cut after the anchor was taken.
Compare with the anchor file and backups.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Reply must be ONLY a JSON array, at most 8 steps, keys runbook,
host, rationale (300 chars max), nothing else. One retry, then escalate.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Dropped before the gate: ids must match the catalogue,
hosts must belong to the incident.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
The model call failed: nothing runs, a human is paged.
Fall back to the heuristic planner.

div.style: display: table; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The path names the key (e.g. $.events[0]).
Compare with a file in scenarios/.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Use a name from fleetgate scenarios or a .json path;
set --scenario-dir / FLEETGATE_SCENARIO_DIR.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p: Two files declare the same name: names must be unique.

div.style: color: rgb(0, 0, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 320px; text-align: center; width: 320px;

span.p:
Return repaired hosts (undrain_host, restore_rack), add spare capacity
(CapacityAgent report), or raise max_drained_fraction in your own
policy copy. The plan stops and a human is paged.
